headline: Credo Brands submits September quarter demat compliance report
hook: Routine regulatory filing for Credo Brands
summary: Credo Brands Marketing Limited has filed its demat compliance certificate with SEBI for the quarter ended September 2024. This is a standard regulatory requirement for listed companies to confirm the reconciliation of share capital. The filing ensures the company remains in compliance with depository participant regulations. It does not impact the company's operational performance or financial outlook.
